layouts.name: Visor HUD (custom)
layouts.desc: A developer-imported stage layout: a cyan tactical HUD with corner brackets, scanlines and a glowing readout panel for the line.

meta.description: A tiny GalForge demo that shows how the galforge-import-layout and galforge-import-adhoc skills wire developer-built presentation into a project: a custom stage layout (`visor`, registered in ui.layouts) and an adhoc-scene quiz module (§14). See README.md.
